title: Best Trash Can (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were selected by comparing product mentions across Consumer Reports, CNET, TechGearLab, Car & Driver, and Yahoo Shopping. Products cited by more than one source were prioritized, and features such as odor control, smart functionality, and price were used to rank them.
assumptions: Prices are not included because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a busy kitchen where you need a quick, odor‑free trash solution. The Simplehuman Rectangular Step Can offers a sealed lid and a step‑down design that keeps smells locked in and is easy to open with one hand. It outperforms other picks by providing the best odor containment and a sleek, stainless‑steel look. The catch: it is the most expensive option in this guide.
